# Configuration reference

toyq reads its settings from defaults, then `toyq.toml`, then `TOYQ_*` environment variables; the last one wins.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `db_path` | `TOYQ_DB_PATH` | string | `toyq.sqlite` |
| `max_retries` | `TOYQ_MAX_RETRIES` | integer | `3` |
| `retry_backoff_seconds` | `TOYQ_RETRY_BACKOFF` | float | `5.0` |
| `job_timeout_seconds` | `TOYQ_JOB_TIMEOUT` | integer | `600` |
| `log_level` | `TOYQ_LOG_LEVEL` | string | `info` |

`max_retries` must be 0 or more.

file:docs/reference/configuration.md.output:
# Configuration reference

tidewatch reads its settings from defaults, then `tidewatch.toml`, then `TIDEWATCH_*` environment variables; the last one wins.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `poll_interval_seconds` | `TIDEWATCH_POLL_INTERVAL` | float | `2.0` |
| `debounce_ms` | `TIDEWATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS` | integer | `250` |
| `max_hooks_in_flight` | `TIDEWATCH_MAX_HOOKS` | integer | `4` |
| `hook_timeout_seconds` | `TIDEWATCH_HOOK_TIMEOUT` | integer | `300` |
| `follow_symlinks` | `TIDEWATCH_FOLLOW_SYMLINKS` | boolean | `false` |
| `log_format` | `TIDEWATCH_LOG_FORMAT` | string | `text` |
| `state_dir` | `TIDEWATCH_STATE_DIR` | path | `~/.local/state/tidewatch` |

`tidewatch check` reports every setting that breaks a rule: `poll_interval_seconds` must be more than 0, `debounce_ms` 0 or more, `max_hooks_in_flight` 1 or more, and `log_format` one of `text` or `json`.
